name: NASA Picture of the Day
description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day: today's, a day you choose, or a random day. A day with a video instead of a picture is passed over (today, random) or reported (a chosen day). The picture is fitted to the screen with a blurred margin. No key is needed.

credit.text: Astronomy Picture of the Day, NASA
credit.license: Each picture's own: NASA's are public domain, others are their authors', as the day's page says

properties.name: contentCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Downloads (hours)
properties.description: The longest a downloaded picture is kept and shared by every task before it is asked for again. The site's own headers can shorten this, never lengthen it. 0: download every time.

properties.name: contentCacheMB
properties.title: Downloads Pool Size (MB)
properties.description: The most disk the kept downloads of this data source may use. When it is full, the one used longest ago goes first.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Downloads After (days)
properties.description: A kept download nobody has used for this many days is removed. 0: never.

properties.name: randomizeDate
properties.title: Randomize Date
properties.description: A random day since 16 June 1995, when the Picture of the Day began, each time.

properties.name: customDate
properties.title: Custom Date
properties.description: A day to show. Not used when the date is randomized. Empty: today's picture (or the latest one, until today's is published).
